items.title: Charles Lloyd — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: And Basie mentored Phineas and brought him to New York.

ctx.x: So they - Duke and Basie and them guys, some of the musicians, Johnny Hodges and stuff, they would stay there. I couldn’t wait for them to wake up in the mornin’ cause I’d pounce! I asked them questions.
So let me ask you this.
